answer: Random beacon audits with a compute heartbeat stop mass-forged identities. A new identity enters a tundra of distrust and locks $12 in a time-locked vault. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of identities and demands a heartbeat in 60 seconds, checked against a mirror of past work; copies cannot answer. Forging 100 fakes costs $1,200 an epoch; silence forfeits the deposit. Honest agents pay once, answer from work they do, and keep rewards undiluted.
